newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly firmer in after-hours trade on Tuesday as bargain hunting emerged after losses during the day, traders said.

The newly listed benchmark July contract was the only contract to move lower, slipping to 142.7 yen per kg, off 0.2 yen from the day's close. The other contracts ranged from flat to 0.8 yen above the day's close. Volume was 5,863 lots.

During the day, the market virtually ignored bullish factors such as a fall in Japan's rubber stocks and the weak yen. "Sentiment remains bearish, as Thai rubber offer prices to Japan continued to fall," one trader said.
